verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages for listing tasks, cancelling tasks and sending events, and its quickstart includes copy-paste code examples. Nothing shows the reference is interactive (no try-it console or playground), and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, evidence that examples are runnable in-page, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Smooth API enables programmatic browser automation through REST endpoints.
List all tasks for the authenticated user.
Cancel a running task by its ID.
task = smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight from London to Paris today")
